payload.claim: The docstring for `_resolve` attributes the "forgiving" rev-parse-failure-reads-as-absent rule to `saffron/repos/mirror.py`'s `ref_commit`, but no function named `ref_commit` exists in `saffron/repos/mirror.py` at all. `ref_commit` is defined in this same file, `saffron/mutants.py`, at line 36 (the reader's own function). The citation points a future reader to the wrong module for the precedent it is invoking.
